Description

There is an abundance of gyms but Magnet Leisure Centre, based in Maidenhead, is an excellent one. The vast array of equipment to use makes it easy to train the entire body and means that you’re not lingering around in the gym waiting for the piece of equipment that you actually came to the gym for.

The friendly and knowledgeable staff at Magnet Leisure Centre makes joining easier as they not only know the best exercises for you to reach your goals but also like to get to know you and do their best to ensure you don’t injure yourself.

If you’re travelling by car, then you’ll be glad to know there is free parking provided by the venue. The free parking at the facility can fill up at peak times and get busy, with weekends being a very popular time, so allow ample time to ensure you secure a space.

If you’re feeling like a one off game just isn’t good enough and you want all the benefits that come with a membership, like feeling part of that community and team, then the venue does offer membership. Enjoy as many games as you like for a monthly or annual fee. Please get in touch to find out more information.

Looking to set up regular games at Magnet Leisure Centre? Enquire about making a block booking to ensure you secure the time slot you want to play at every week. Block bookings are perfect for teams who want to be assured that they'll be playing regularly. A block booking is a booking made for a set number of consecutive weeks, on average this is 10 weeks.

The venue is situated near Maidenhead station. From there it is a short walk to the facility which works out well for a gentle warm down after your booking.
